summary: Avoid custom projection invalidations for unrelated claims and unchanged updates

replay.detail: Existing custom projection rows remain valid; no claim replay or cache rebuild is required.

schema.detail: Install a local claim-to-custom-invalidation view and replace changed custom triggers once on open. Unchanged reopens preserve the schema cookie. Batch, record and suffix-order invalidations retain custom sources, registry-prefix expansion, dependency consumers (including non-custom inputs and claim references), and registration document bindings.

rules.detail: Signed claim authority, canonical ordering, registration semantics and custom projection results are unchanged. Null-safe UPDATE guards only skip unchanged source columns.

compatibility.detail: No public API, replication protocol or claim format changes. Ordinary non-custom claims without custom consumers no longer enter the custom dirty queue.

downtime.detail: The normal store-open schema transaction installs the local trigger changes.

recovery.detail: Custom projections remain derived caches recoverable from the signed claim log through the existing rebuild path.
